2026-07-27 ~01:00Z — LOCAL MACHINE FULLY CONVERGED + home cookiesync leg COMPLETE. Box recipe amended (critical).

**Local**: after v0.20.9 + captain-hook 12.20.12 shipped, the brew-postinstall retry failed with a NEW root cause — Homebrew's formula-postinstall sandbox denies file-write-create in ~/Library/LaunchAgents at ANY path (the v0.20.9 real-home fix itself is field-confirmed: diagnostic showed the real path, zero launchd EPERM/EIO). Convergence completed via daemonkit's own caller from an unsandboxed shell: `capt-hookd package-install` (the formula's post_install invocation), after clearing three fail-closed guards (stale 12.20.11 candidate, orphaned 12.20.9 app, retained state dir — all moved to ~/captain-hook-retry-20260726/). Result: bundle 12.20.12 delivered, sealed receipts, KEYLESS helper plist regenerated by daemonkit at the real path, host.v1 PID 81227 + helper PID 81205 both fresh and exit-0, `capt-hook helper status` → "helper v12.20.12 ok=True" (the pre-existing "bridge failed" symptom cleared with the version-skew — 191e5724 may be affected). The days-old wedge is over; hooks' signed-host-ready gate passes.

**Home**: cookiesync 0.27.3 converged after a lossless state migration (0.27.3 shipped a breaking envelope hard-cut with no migration — bug filed in cookiesync backlog; helper died at cask upgrade because Caskroom purge kills the resident binary). Keyless helper live, doctor 7/7, 15-min window stable, serve counter still 1224. Cell test #2 (keyless × daemonkit-caller × .app × SSH real-HOME) PASSED. Caveat: the .app-class Program is NOT daemonkit-staged (synckit daemon/service.go:105-118 — LookPath only), so the plist bakes the versioned Caskroom 0.27.3 path; the next cask upgrade re-breaks it until synckit 3886b75 lands. Touch-ID/Keychain consent unverified over SSH — verify on the next physical session.

**BOX RECIPE AMENDMENT (applies to queued step: brew upgrade captain-hook)**: the box's `brew upgrade captain-hook` postinstall WILL fail by sandbox design. After the upgrade, run the delivered Cellar's `capt-hookd package-install` directly from the SSH shell (real HOME + unsandboxed = the proven-working cell). If it hits the fail-closed guards on stale state, follow the three move-asides recorded above and in the daemonkit ergonomics task. Same applies to any machine converging captain-hook via brew until the formula moves delivery out of postinstall (bug filed in captain-hook backlog).

Remaining open on this task: box (dark, watcher armed), cc-pool re-auth both machines (user-gated), home peer registration (box dark).
